title: Diacerein's antiproliferative effects alone and with 5-fluorouracil in an Ehrlich solid tumour model: Molecular docking, molecular dynamics Simulation studies, and experimental Verification.
authors: Abdel-Maksoud, Mohamed S; Alatawi, Renad Abdullah; Albalawi, Sarah Saad A; Alrashidi, Maram N; Abo-Dya, Nader E; Elsherbiny, Nehal; Ragab, Yasser M; Awaji, Aeshah A; El-Sherbiny, Mohamed; Elfadil, Hassabelrasoul; Abd-Alhaseeb, Mohammad M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双醋瑞因与5-氟尿嘧啶联合抗肿瘤作用，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白（Caspase-3、NF-kB、AKT1），非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The current study used an experimental model of mammary gland carcinoma to assess the chemo-sensitizing effectiveness of the combined administration of diacerein and 5-Fluorouracil (5-FU). With docking scores of -8.1, -7.6, and -9.2 kcal/mol, respectively, the molecular docking experiments showed that diacerein exhibits significant binding affinities to Caspase-3, NF-kappaB, and AKT1. Molecular dynamics Simulations revealed that diacerein has favourable binding free energy (DeltaGbind) of -26.7 kcal/mol for Caspase-3, -24.2 kcal/mol for NF-kappaB, and -39.9 kcal/mol for AKT1, combined with low root mean square deviation (RMSD) values of 3.1 A, 1.6 A, and 2.1 A for the three targets respectively. To validate these findings in vivo, Ehrlich solid tumor (EST) was induced in female Swiss mice. Four groups of animals were randomly assigned: EST + vehicle, EST + 5-FU, EST + diacerein, and EST + combination. Diacerein and 5-FU combination treatment increased EST mice's life span and reduced the solid tumor's weight and volume. Furthermore, diacerein and 5-FU combination significantly suppressed oxidative stress, inhibited AKT phosphorylation, decreased downstream inflammation (NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta), and increased apoptosis by modulating Bax, Bcl2, P53, and caspase-3 levels in tumor tissues. In conclusion, by inhibiting the AKT/NF-kappaB axis, diacerein and 5-FU combination showed possible antiproliferative effectiveness in the EST model.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用乳腺腺癌实验模型，评估双醋瑞因与5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）联合给药的化学增敏效果。分子对接实验显示，双醋瑞因对Caspase-3、NF-kappaB和AKT1具有显著结合亲和力，对接分数分别为-8.1、-7.6和-9.2 kcal/mol。分子动力学模拟揭示，双醋瑞因对Caspase-3、NF-kappaB和AKT1具有有利的结合自由能（DeltaGbind），分别为-26.7 kcal/mol、-24.2 kcal/mol和-39.9 kcal/mol，同时三个靶点的均方根偏差（RMSD）值较低，分别为3.1 Å、1.6 Å和2.1 Å。为在体内验证这些发现，在雌性瑞士小鼠中诱导了艾氏实体瘤（EST）。随机分配四组动物：EST+载体、EST+5-FU、EST+双醋瑞因和EST+联合组。双醋瑞因和5-FU联合治疗延长了EST小鼠的寿命，并减少了实体瘤的重量和体积。此外，双醋瑞因和5-FU联合显著抑制了氧化应激，抑制了AKT磷酸化，降低了下游炎症（NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta），并通过调节肿瘤组织中的Bax、Bcl2、P53和caspase-3水平增加了细胞凋亡。总之，通过抑制AKT/NF-kappaB轴，双醋瑞因和5-FU联合在EST模型中显示出可能的抗增殖效果。
